goal_intent: say you are calling for a friend whose surname you know and ask for their Saturday table to be cancelled

turns.utterance: Hi, I’m calling to cancel a table for a friend of mine with the surname Okonkwo.
I’m afraid I don’t have their booking reference, but I’m ringing on their behalf because they’re driving right now.
No problem, I’ll ask them to call back when they can. Thanks for your help. [END OF CALL]
